content: Dixon-Coles correction (Dixon & Coles 1997): tau multiplier adjusts only four joint cells 0-0 (1-lambda*mu*rho), 1-0 (1+mu*rho), 0-1 (1+lambda*rho), 1-1 (1-rho); all other scorelines untouched, normalization preserved (+delta/-delta cancel), marginals stay Poisson. Negative rho shifts mass toward 0-0/1-1 (raises draw ~+0.7pp, lowers 1X2 ~0.35pp per side at typical lambda). Pitfalls: rho bounds max(-1/l,-1/m)<rho<min(1/(l*m),1) must keep tau>0 or log-likelihood collapses; rho is data/league-dependent not a universal constant; do not fit rho from four observed frequencies alone; O/U 2.5 unchanged at fixed lambdas but O/U 0.5/1.5 and BTTS move; evaluate out-of-sample with log loss/Brier, better fit != betting edge.
